children: Hong Kong-listed American depositary receipts were mostly higher than their local closing prices, with gains led by China Pacific Insurance, Cathay Pacific and Ping An, according to ETNet.

Among the larger moves, China Pacific Insurance ADRs were 3.25% above the Hong Kong close, Cathay Pacific rose 3.31%, and Ping An gained 3.25%. China Life, PetroChina, BYD, China Mobile and several other names were not quoted in the ADR table. The comparison was calculated using an exchange rate of US$1 to HK$7.8427.

title: Hong Kong ADRs Mostly Higher Before Local Market Open
